Video Games

Explore my game projects!

Into the Depths

A 2D roguelike deckbuilder inspired by the likes of Slay the Spire, developed in the Godot engine. It was created by me as the sole developer with the enemy art created by artist Yuuki Matsuda (@_yam.exe on Instagram). With a focus on replayability, I placed a strong emphasis on enemy variety and many possible builds for the player to create.
